**Biodôme.** Espace pour la vie's own site says 
its museums will be open on Mondays October 12 (Thanksgiving), December 21 and 28 (Holidays)
. It also says 
the museums will be closed on December 24 and 25
. The page I read gave boutique hours of 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Tuesday to Sunday. I did not find the Biodôme's own opening hours for Dec 27-30, so I left out a time. The Biodôme page describes its 
programming designed for all ages
. No price was posted on what I read.

**Kazoom Café.** Their site says 
the toddler play area for children 3 and under includes a little slide and stimulating toys
. They have a Ville Saint-Laurent location and one in Brossard. I found no holiday hours or prices for Dec 27-30, so those are left out and they would need a call or a check of their site.

**Left out.**
- **Montréal Science Centre:** its own holiday-hours pages that I found were from earlier years. The Dec 27-30 hours I saw came from a museum listings site, and the toddler-area details came from travel sites. Neither is the venue's own page.
- **Zükari:** its page lists a toddler zone for ages 0-4 and some holiday hours. I couldn't confirm where it is, or its hours for Dec 27-30.
